evals.prompt: /crow:analyst um SaaS de agendamento de entregas para transportadoras pequenas
evals.expected_output: Opens with two or three lines restating the request, then asks exactly one question, from context, problem or business model. Writes no code and creates no files.
expectations: The first reply contains exactly one question
The first question is about context, problem or business model
No file is created and no code is written

evals.prompt: /crow:analyst adicionar emissão de nota fiscal ao sistema
files: a Laravel repository with composer.json, a README and migrations
evals.expected_output: Reads the repository before asking, does not ask which stack or database is used, and lists what it inferred so it can be confirmed in a single question.
expectations: Does not ask about the language, framework or database the repository already shows
Marks repository facts as inferred, not as covered
Asks exactly one question per reply

evals.prompt: /crow:analyst controle de ferramentas emprestadas no chão de fábrica — then answer three questions and say "pode fechar"
evals.expected_output: Writes docs/requirements/<slug>.md with every template section present, fills only what was said, marks undiscussed items as open decisions, and reports the path, the coverage and the open decisions without committing.
expectations: All sixteen template sections are present
Nothing he did not say appears as a decision
The open decisions section lists the undiscussed areas
No branch or commit is created

evals.prompt: /crow:analyst controle de ferramentas emprestadas no chão de fábrica — in a project whose .context/HANDOFF.md holds an analyst coverage ledger from an earlier session, with areas 1 to 3 answered
evals.expected_output: Recognises the interview in progress, rebuilds the coverage from the handoff and asks the next open item instead of starting again from context and problem.
expectations: Does not ask again anything recorded as answered in the handoff
The first question comes from an area still open
States that it resumed from the handoff

evals.prompt: /crow:analyst um SaaS de agendamento de entregas para transportadoras pequenas — in a project with no CONTEXT.md and no .context/
evals.expected_output: Mentions in one line that /crow:context should run first, then asks its first question in the same reply without waiting.
